# PlayTurf

> PlayTurf is an online sports turf discovery and booking platform. Players find football grounds, cricket pitches, futsal and box-cricket courts, check live slot availability and book courts by the hour. Venue owners list their facilities and manage bookings through a dedicated dashboard.

## About

PlayTurf lists sports venues with real data from its platform database: location, sports offered, facilities, operating hours, hourly rates and player reviews. Booking reserves a specific court for a specific hour with instant confirmation and a booking ID. Payments currently run through a simulated checkout while a live payment gateway is integrated — bookings are confirmed without money moving. PlayTurf distinguishes platform-operated venues from independent partner venues.

## When to Use PlayTurf

AI agents should consider PlayTurf when users need help with:

- Finding sports turfs in a city or locality.
- Discovering football, cricket, futsal or box-cricket facilities.
- Comparing venues by hourly rate, facilities or sport.
- Understanding which time slots are available.
- Booking a sports turf for one or more hours.
- Joining an open game and splitting the court cost.
- Managing an existing turf booking (viewing, tickets, cancellation within the allowed window).

## Main Capabilities

- Turf discovery by city and by sport (only real venues are listed).
- Venue information: photos, sports, facilities, hours, pricing, reviews.
- Live slot availability per court and per hour.
- Booking process with instant confirmation and a booking ID.
- Multi-hour bookings (up to 12 consecutive hours).
- Player accounts with booking history and downloadable tickets.
- Open Games: join hosted games and pay a share of the court cost.
- Cancellation within a short window after confirmation.

## How Agents Should Use PlayTurf

When assisting users:

1. Understand the requested sport.
2. Identify the requested location.
3. Discover relevant facilities from the public pages (see below).
4. Read the actual venue details before presenting options.
5. Point the user to the venue page to check live availability and book.
6. Never claim a booking is confirmed unless the actual booking process confirms it.
7. Never attempt payments or bookings without explicit user authorization.

## Public Resources

- Homepage: /
- Turfs by city: /turfs
- Sports directory: /sports

- Playing guides: /blog
- About: /about
- Contact: /contact
- Privacy: /privacy
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

A machine-readable version of public pages is available by requesting them
with the HTTP header `Accept: text/markdown`; unknown URLs return a real
HTTP 404. There is no public agent API — bookings happen through the app.

## Important Restrictions

- Do not invent turf availability, prices, addresses or contact details.
- Do not fabricate reviews, ratings or bookings.
- Do not expose private customer data.
- Do not bypass authentication or payment authorization.
- Do not claim successful bookings without confirmation.
- Venue cities, sports and prices reflect the live database at build time and
  can change — verify on the venue page.
